title: SugarcaneBonemeal
description: Allows you to bonemeal sugarcane just like in bedrock edition, with full support for dispenser aswell as custom items if you want.
body:
# SugarcaneBonemeal This is a simple, lightweight Fabric mod that lets you use bonemeal on sugarcane to speed up its growth. It also works with dispensers, so automated farms can take advantage of it too. Each bonemeal use grows sugarcane by 2 blocks, just like Bedrock. ## Features * **Bonemeal on sugarcane** - Right-click sugarcane with bonemeal (duh) * **Dispenser support** - Hook up a dispenser with bonemeal pointing at your sugarcane and it works the same way. * **Bedrock parity** - Sugarcane grows 2 blocks per bonemeal, matching Bedrock Edition behavior, which is the place form where this idea comes from. * **Sound and particles** - Proper Vanilla sound and particles. ## Installation 1. Download the jar 2. Drop it in your `mods` folder 3. Restart or reload your game 4. That's it. Sugarcane is now bonemealable :} ## Requirements * Fabric, Areed's CoreLib ***
